# Zain Ventures India — Inter-State Bus Hire from Rourkela

> Zain Ventures India is a bus rental, tempo traveller and car-hire service based in Rourkela, Odisha (India). We specialise in **inter-state travel from Rourkela** to destinations across Odisha, Jharkhand, West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh. AC and Non-AC buses (20 / 30 / 35 / 40 / 50-seater), tempo travellers (12 / 17-seater), premium sedans, SUVs, and cargo trucks. Available 24/7 with professional drivers, GPS tracking and full insurance. Established 2014.

## What we do (one-line summary)
Inter-state coaches, tempo travellers and chauffeured cars from Rourkela for weddings, pilgrimages, corporate transit, school trips and outstation tourism — across four Indian states.

## Services

- **Inter-state bus hire** — AC / Non-AC, 20-50 seater, with professional driver
- **Wedding & event bus** — decorated luxury coaches for baraat, marriages, engagements
- **Corporate transportation** — daily employee shuttles, conferences, team outings, offsites
- **School & college trip bus** — GPS-tracked, with experienced drivers; group rates
- **Pilgrimage / tirth yatra bus** — Puri, Varanasi, Deoghar, Gaya
- **Outstation tour** — across Odisha, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh
- **Tempo traveller rental** — 12 or 17 seater AC vehicle for family groups
- **Premium car rental** — chauffeured sedans and SUVs
- **Cargo truck rental** — local & interstate freight, multiple capacities

## Fleet (vehicles available for rent)

- Mini Bus — 20 / 25 seater (AC and Non-AC)

- Push-back Seat Bus — comfortable recline for long journeys

## Pricing model

Per-kilometre rate × trip distance + driver allowance. Specific rate depends on vehicle type, AC / non-AC, and duration. Non-AC mini bus rates start lowest; 50-seater AC luxury coaches sit at the top end. Wedding-decorated coaches priced separately. **Always call for an exact quote** — no hidden charges.
